parsed.name: Livox三维激光雷达
parsed.description: Livox三维激光雷达是一类用于获取空间三维点云的激光传感器，可输出点的坐标、距离/角度表示、反射率、回波信息，以及部分记录中的IMU数据。它常用于实验室中的三维扫描、机器人感知、空间测绘、目标检测和点云重建。
parsed.description_en: Livox 3D LiDAR is a laser-based spatial sensor used to acquire 3D point clouds. It can provide point coordinates, range/angle representations, reflectivity, return information, and in some recordings IMU data. In laboratories it is commonly used for 3D scanning, robotic perception, spatial mapping, object detection, and point-cloud reconstruction.

actions.description: 读取数据类型0点数据：笛卡尔坐标X/Y/Z、反射率和回波编号。
actions.description_en: Read type-0 point data: Cartesian X/Y/Z coordinates, reflectivity, and return number.

actions.description: 读取数据类型1点数据：距离、天顶角、方位角、反射率和回波编号。
actions.description_en: Read type-1 point data: distance, zenith angle, azimuth angle, reflectivity, and return number.

actions.description: 读取数据类型2点数据：笛卡尔坐标X/Y/Z、反射率、回波编号和标签信息。

actions.description_en: Read type-5 dual-return point data: two sets of range/angle values, reflectivity, return numbers, and tag information.

actions.description: 读取数据类型6惯性测量数据：角速度和加速度。
